entities.summary: The University of Mataram (Indonesian: Universitas Mataram) (Unram) is a public university in Mataram, West Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia. It was established on October 1, 1962. Its current rector is Prof. Ir. Bambang Hari Kusumo, M.Agr.St., PhD.
